transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brought you in to see me today?

I guess… I just can’t sit still. Feels like there’s a motor running inside me all day. If I’m at church, or here at the clinic, or even at home, I start feeling trapped and I have to get up or do something.
Have you recently started or changed the dose of any medications, especially antipsychotics, anti-nausea drugs, or other psychiatric medications, around the time this restlessness began?
I don’t think so… I mean, I haven’t really changed anything like that that I know of. Nothing comes to mind.
When you feel this need to move, are you also experiencing worried or anxious thoughts running through your mind, or is it mainly just a physical urge to move without much worrying?
It’s mostly… like my body won’t settle. Not really thoughts going crazy or worrying. More like I got this motor in me, and if I’m sitting too long, I feel trapped and need to get up.

Is this restless feeling mainly in your legs with an uncomfortable or crawling sensation that gets worse in the evening or at night, or is it more of a whole-body urge to move that happens at any time of day?
It’s more like my whole body, I guess. Like I got a motor running inside me. It can happen any time… if I’m sitting at church or here, or even at home, I start feeling trapped and need to get up.
Aside from the urge to move, do you find yourself worrying excessively about various things—like work, health, or family—more days than not, even when there's little reason to?
Not really, no. I mean… I worry some, like anybody, but I wouldn’t say it’s all the time or about everything.

Are you currently taking, or have you ever taken, any antipsychotic medications or anti-nausea drugs like metoclopramide or prochlorperazine, even if it was a while ago or you're still on a stable dose?
I don’t think so. Those names don’t sound familiar to me… I’m not on anything like that right now.
Have you taken any other medications recently, such as antidepressants, antihistamines, or stimulant drugs, even over-the-counter or recreational ones?
Um… not that I can think of. I might take something from the store once in a while, but I don’t really know the names. Nothing regular.
Would you say you've felt this restless, need-to-move feeling since you were a child or teenager, or did it start only recently, within the past few weeks or months?
It’s been since I was a kid, I think. In school they’d move my seat around because I couldn’t sit still, and I’d talk when I wasn’t supposed to… sometimes I’d get up before class was even over.
